Criteria: Explosive run-up, jump onto the springboard with both feet together at the same time.
Keep legs closed and straight in the air. Place hands in a straight line approximately ¾ from the far end of the block.
Push hard with straight arms to get hips higher than shoulders. Open legs wide and keep them straight.
Bring legs back together. Keep the body tight and straight as the hips come down until feet touch the mat.
Arrive in a stable, upright position, bringing arms up to help absorb the impact. A maximum of one adjustment step is permitted.
